value.rationale: The source investigates whether a two-parameter cusp survives a numerical discretization but gives local conclusions. The result controls every positive orbit across the entire parameter and step domain, sharply excluding step-induced cycles, and computes a global critical asymptotic through signed square-root and logarithmic terms.
